readme: Pinned upstream sources for the vendored .proto tree in ./proto. Run `pnpm proto:sync` to re-materialize it; CI runs `pnpm proto:check`, which syncs and fails on any diff. Bumping a commit is a deliberate, reviewable change — the diff shows exactly what the wire contract gained.

sources.name: skywalking-banyandb-client-proto
sources.note: Pinned to a commit id on main, which is synced from the BanyanDB server. Carries the 0.11.0 surface: SchemaBarrierService, STATUS_SCHEMA_NOT_APPLIED, created_at, plus mod_revision, sharding_key and replicas. The Java client SDK is deprecated (frozen at BanyanDB 0.9.0) and upstream directs consumers to implement locally against these definitions, so this repo — not that SDK — is the contract's home.
sources.track: main — this commit id is main's tip as of the pinned date. Re-pin to the commit id of the BanyanDB 0.11 release when the repo publishes one; until then main is the only ref carrying the 0.11 contract.

sources.name: protoc-gen-validate
sources.note: Every banyandb .proto does `import "validate/validate.proto"`, and the BanyanDB proto repo does not vendor it — without this the tree does not load at all. google/protobuf/* needs no entry: @grpc/proto-loader carries the well-known types.
